title: unu garages v2
description: Curated list of garages that service unu electric scooters. Short-key encoding: n=name, p=phone (E.164), s=street and house number, z=postal code, c=city, cc=ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, ll=[lat,lng] WGS84, w=website, d=official unu dealer, r=confirmed unu repairs (-1 unknown, 0 no, 1 yes), v=verification date. garages_v2.json contains only confirmed-accepting garages (st omitted); garages-source.json contains all entries with st.

s.description: Street and house number (canonical local spelling)

z.description: Postal code (string: NL/CH/etc. contain letters; leading zeros preserved)

c.description: City (canonical postal city, without district suffixes)

ll.description: [latitude, longitude] in WGS84, rounded to 5 decimals (~1 m)

d.description: Official unu dealer: 1=yes, 0=no. Only present on published entries when 1.

r.description: Confirmed unu repair service: 1=yes, 0=no, -1=unknown. Published garages_v2.json contains entries with r=1 or d=true; r may be omitted there when 1? no - kept.

lp.description: Librescoot partner garage: 1=yes, 0=no. Only present on published entries when 1.
